sloka: स महा बाहुः अत्यर्थम् प्रसार्य विपुलौ भुजौ ।जग्राह सहितौ एव राघवौ पीडयन् बलात् ॥३-६९-३५॥
transliteration: sa mahā bāhuḥ atyartham prasārya vipulau bhujau ।jagrāha sahitau eva rāghavau pīḍayan balāt ॥3-69-35॥

translations.english: The longarmed demon spread his hands and caught hold of Rama and Lakshmana together by pressing them with all his force.
